comment: Single source of truth for the arcade catalog. tools/build_games.py generates the hub index.html from this file and builds every game whose 'key' matches a GAMES entry. Hand-built games (generated: false) are listed here for the hub only. Adding a game = one entry here + one GAMES block in build_games.py.

games.title: Polymerase Runner
games.teach: Transcription: you are RNA polymerase — pair the bases by hydrogen bonds, watch T shatter into U at the transcription zone, and build an mRNA.
games.description: Play transcription: pair bases by hydrogen bonds, shatter T into U at the transcription zone, and build an mRNA.

games.title: Ribosome Snake
games.teach: Translation: the ribosome reads codons AUG → stop, tRNAs deliver amino acids, and release factors end the chain at UAA / UAG / UGA.
games.description: Play translation: read codons, deliver amino acids, and end the chain at a stop codon with a release factor.

games.title: Fold-Tris
games.teach: The hydrophobic effect: oily residues bury in the core, polar ones face water — and misfolding leads to aggregation unless chaperones step in.
games.description: Play protein folding: bury the hydrophobic core, avoid aggregation, meet the chaperones.

games.title: Phagocyte Patrol
games.teach: Phagocytosis & opsonization: you are a macrophage; antibody tags turn hard-to-catch pathogens into easy meals — innate and adaptive immunity as a team.
games.description: Play innate immunity: patrol the tissue, grab the antibody power-up, engulf opsonized pathogens.

games.title: Drug Flight
games.teach: Pharmacokinetics: dose timing keeps a drug inside its therapeutic window — too high is toxic, too low does nothing, and the liver and kidneys clear it.
games.description: Play pharmacokinetics: dose against clearance and stay inside the therapeutic window.

games.title: Lysis Lab
games.teach: Antibiotics & resistance: wall-targeting drugs burst bacteria but spare your wall-less cells — until β-lactamase appears, and clavulanate counters it.
games.description: Play antibiotic mechanisms: break the peptidoglycan wall, beat beta-lactamase with clavulanate.

games.title: Alignment Grid
games.teach: Needleman–Wunsch: fill the dynamic-programming matrix cell by cell — each cell is the best score so far — then walk the traceback and read the optimal global alignment you just computed.
games.description: Play Needleman-Wunsch global alignment: fill the dynamic-programming matrix, walk the traceback, read the optimal alignment.

games.title: Seed & Extend
games.teach: Why BLASTP is fast: hunt the 3-letter seed word, extend the hit while the score holds, and skip sequences with no seed — trading guaranteed-best for fast, then reading the E-value.
games.description: Play the BLASTP idea: find seed words, extend local hits while the score holds, skip seedless sequences, and read E-values at intuition level.

games.title: Genome Builder
games.teach: De Bruijn assembly: chop reads into k-mers, walk the k−1 overlaps to rebuild the genome — until a repeat branches the graph with equal support, or a one-read error dangles a dead-end tip.
games.description: Play genome assembly: walk the De Bruijn graph by k-mer overlaps, flag repeat ambiguity instead of guessing, prune sequencing-error tips.

games.title: Variant Detective
games.teach: Reasoning under uncertainty: a 2-check evidence budget against each read pileup — base quality, mapping, strands, context — then the verdict: real, artifact, or the honest one, unresolved.
games.description: Play variant review: spend a limited evidence budget on a read pileup and call each site real, artifact, or unresolved.

games.title: Leakage Lab
games.teach: Data leakage: split patients (not rows), fit preprocessing on train only, select features inside the folds — then watch the leaky twin ace cross-validation and collapse on the protected holdout.
games.description: Play honest ML evaluation: group patients across the split, order the pipeline correctly, and see leakage inflate then collapse.

games.title: Pipeline Rescue
games.teach: Workflows as DAGs: wire tasks to their real inputs, trace a crash to its root cause, and resume by rerunning exactly the stale tasks — cached results stay, CPU hours get banked.
games.description: Play reproducible computing: wire the pipeline DAG, find the root cause of a failure, and cache-and-resume without rerunning the world.

games.title: Chromatin Command
games.teach: The acetylation switch: you are the HAT writer — spend acetyl-CoA to open protective gene gates, let HDAC erasers close the stress genes, and feel in-mechanic why an HDAC-inhibitor blockade is powerful and double-edged.
games.description: Play cardiac epigenetics: write acetyl marks, balance writers against erasers, and learn why HDAC inhibitors de-repress helpful and harmful genes alike.

games.title: Cardio Beat
games.teach: Same concept as Chromatin Command, second mechanic: the acetylation switch as rhythm — tap protective-gene lanes exactly when polymerase arrives, leave the stress lane alone, and feel SAHA overdrive auto-hit both.
games.meta: ~6 min · phone-friendly · one concept, three games
games.description: The acetylation switch as a rhythm game: acetylate protective genes on the polymerase beat, ignore the stress lane, survive SAHA overdrive's double edge.

games.title: HAT-a-Mole
games.teach: Same concept, third mechanic: reflex-acetylate protective genes before each polymerase sweep — and learn the eraser lesson hands-on: the HDAC chewing on your mis-marked stress gene is the rescue, not the enemy.
games.meta: ~6 min · phone-friendly · one concept, three games
games.description: The acetylation switch as whack-a-mole: mark protective genes before the sweep, never mark stress genes, and let erasers fix your mistakes.

category_notes.Research frontiers: Concepts from active research programs, turned into playable mechanics. Studying something teachable? The module framework is open — bring your concept.
